reviews.t: Amazon has a great price, so I figured it was worth trying
reviews.x: I'm a yoga teacher and I'm barefoot all day long. As a result, I have some nasty, dry feet. When I found out about this, I was sold on the idea. Amazon has a great price, so I figured it was worth trying. I've only used it once so far, but already my feet feel and look a million times better. reviews.t: A hell of a lot better than those "pedi" products
reviews.x: A hell of a lot better than those "pedi" products.  Works like a charm! Just remember, it takes a few uses before your feet will lose the roughness... there are many layers of hard skin to get through. Oh, and don't use for extended periods in a session - you WILL hurt your skin.

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the product for effectively smoothing dry, callused feet and delivering visible results.
Many reviewers highlight the rechargeable design and strong power as a major advantage over battery-operated alternatives.
A few reviewers report serious durability and charging problems, including the unit failing to hold a charge shortly after purchase.
Some reviewers question the authenticity of positive reviews and criticize the product as overpriced or rebranded.
Reviewers note it works well for minor calluses but may be less suited to heavier callus removal.
